summary_en: This study compares two forms of carmustine, VI-0609 (carmustine with propylene glycol) and BiCNU (carmustine with ethanol), as part of BEAM chemotherapy before autologous stem cell transplant in people with lymphoma. The record does not state the route, the dose, or how long or how often the drugs are given. The main outcome is not stated; the study is a randomized Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio compara dos formas de carmustina, VI-0609 (carmustina con propilenglicol) y BiCNU (carmustina con etanol), como parte de la quimioterapia BEAM antes de un trasplante autólogo de células madre en personas con linfoma. El registro no indica la vía, la dosis, ni cuánto tiempo o con qué frecuencia se administran los medicamentos. El resultado principal no se indica; el estudio es un estudio aleatorizado de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with a life expectancy of at least 6 months.
Candidate for autologous transplant, with a complete or partial response to prior treatment.
Karnofsky performance status of at least 70%.
Has collected at least 2.0 x 10^6 CD34 cells/kg, with heart and lung function within study limits.
not_for: Prior high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplant, or prior allogeneic transplant.
Any active cancer other than lymphoma, or other cancer in remission less than 5 years.
Myelodysplasia or a bone marrow abnormality linked to myelodysplasia.
More than 10% lymphoma in the bone marrow after salvage therapy and before stem cell collection.
Active hepatitis B or C, HBsAg positive, or positive HIV antibody.
